nodes.text: The #HMPV has circulated in humans for at least 60 years and is a common virus that causes upper respiratory infections, and HMPV infections are self-limited. Calling this common virus "unknown" is inconsistent with basic science and essentially fear-mongering. https://t.co/ffeeZk6uZf
